node.title: Re: Strange behaviour when using glob in if condition
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
# do nothing if the directory is not empty return if glob("$directory/*");

[doc://glob] skips filenames beginning with a dot, try return if glob("$directory/{*,.*}");

Update: Actually, upon re-reading the question I think I misunderstood what you are trying to do. Update 2: Yep, see my [id://1187675|other reply] for the solution.
